description: Indian Driving License issued by State Transport Authorities under the Motor Vehicles Act.

field_hints.dl_number: License number format: <STATE-CODE><RTO-CODE><YEAR><SEQUENCE>, e.g. MH0120190123456. Exactly 15–16 alphanumeric characters.
field_hints.full_name: Full name of the license holder as printed on the card.
field_hints.date_of_birth: Format DD/MM/YYYY as printed on the license.
field_hints.address: Permanent residential address as printed. May span multiple lines.
field_hints.issue_date: Date the license was issued. Format DD/MM/YYYY.
field_hints.expiry_date: Date the license expires. Format DD/MM/YYYY. Non-transport licenses are valid for 20 years.
field_hints.vehicle_classes: List of vehicle class codes authorised, e.g. ['LMV', 'MCWG', 'TRANS']. Extract all codes present.
field_hints.blood_group: Blood group if printed, e.g. A+, O-, B+.
field_hints.father_or_husband_name: Father's or husband's name if printed, prefixed with F/O or H/O.
field_hints.issuing_authority: Name of the RTO office that issued the license.
field_hints.cov_details: Class of Vehicle details table if present.
field_hints.hazardous_valid_till: Validity date for hazardous goods authorization if present.
field_hints.hill_valid_till: Validity date for hill driving authorization if present.

validation_hints.dl_number: Starts with 2-letter state code (e.g. MH, DL, TN). Total 15–16 characters, alphanumeric only.
validation_hints.date_of_birth: Format DD/MM/YYYY. Age should be >= 16 years.
validation_hints.issue_date: Format DD/MM/YYYY. Must be on or before expiry_date.
validation_hints.expiry_date: Format DD/MM/YYYY. Typically 20 years after issue_date for non-transport.
validation_hints.blood_group: One of: A+, A-, B+, B-, AB+, AB-, O+, O-.
validation_hints.vehicle_classes: Each code should be one of the standard Indian vehicle class codes: MC, MCWG, LMV, LMV-NT, TRANS, HMV, HGV, MGV, etc.
